rapport_notes: Patient through a long, meandering call with a talkative customer; handled the price objection gracefully and without being pushy.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Joe, let's talk about your move. What are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today for your upcoming move?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Well, availability was one. So, we have that. What time do you start in the morning?... (each concern — hours, truck size, cost — got one direct answer before moving to the next topic)
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: I would like to reiterate that this is an estimate... we will only bill you for the actual hours rendered.

top_strength: Handled a firm price objection with grace and facts (explained the weekday/weekend rate difference and the all-inclusive nature of the rate) without getting defensive or losing the relationship.
coaching_note: The quid-pro-quo framing came several exchanges into the call instead of up front, and none of the concerns raised (timing, truck size, cost) got real two-layer follow-up before moving to the next topic.
